planned_work.title: Initial centralized Git-reviewed TaviX extension repository
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Create separate tavix ZipRunner project, stage Atrium and Companion compiled releases under root extensions/, validate immutable manifests/hashes and feed index; verify local tests; operator review and push separate.

planned_work.title: Connect published static TaviX repository to Tavi App Store
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: After Git-reviewed push enable Pages and confirm HTTPS public index/assets/CORS, then subscribe on Windows/Android/web and check consented install/update/source transitions. Klondike clean phone Store discovery must pass before user taps Install.

planned_work.title: Repair Windows TaviX repository build checks
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: On Windows ZipRunner 0.1.1, run 10 tests and the strict repository index integrity check successfully. Verify application assets and published index remain unchanged.

planned_work.title: Safe Windows overlay index reconciliation
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Run original 0.1.5 installer tests and the strict catalog check successfully on Windows after bounded preflight; reject tampering and publisher changes; operator reviews index diff before any publication.

planned_work.title: Fix repository-index check in persisted ZipRunner build sequence
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Existing Windows ZipRunner two-command build succeeds on safe canonical or validated older-index overlay, but fails closed on missing/tampered/unreviewed releases; report index change and require operator diff review; preserve installer and approval gates.

planned_work.title: Establish and maintain source-based C4 model
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Provide architecture/c4/workspace.dsl and README.adoc at source ZIP root with verified TaviX components, L1/L2 context, relevant dynamic/deployment diagrams, source evidence, explicit limitations, reusable stable identifiers; validate using Structurizr CLI if available; maintain in future component changes.

planned_work.title: TaviX source-grounded developer contract and maintenance
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Document actual manifest, archive and SDK wire boundaries and known host limitations; publish machine-readable index and code-backed tests; provide standalone hello example; preserve approval gates.

planned_work.title: Add backward-compatible TaviX game/app classification and cross-project contract
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Validate optional type/categories in archive and local install; legacy app default, schema/documentation/examples, proposal for Tavi trusted registry/Atrium inventory and launch, exact-package regression tests and review gates.

planned_work.title: TaviX asset dependency and permission request contract
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Validate optional assetDependencies and requested permissions in package, archive and staging; provide host-only per-pack grant subset spec, cross-project evidence, schemas, docs, C4, example and tests; no production host authority claimed.

planned_work.title: Privileged host-mediated asset registry administration contract
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: TaviX request-only manifest permission, strict host-wire request/response schemas and docs, native confirmation, LoopRD authority, revocation, no implicit grant, source tests; no backend or automatic publication.

planned_work.title: Host-mediated local file import contract and SDK
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Validate optional fileImports manifest and permission, specify strict picker/read/close/cancel wire, provide negotiated SDK and packable reference app, test fail-closed host and detached transport, preserve existing packages and approval gates; native host belongs to Tavi.

planned_work.title: Portable developer kit conformance command
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Pass exact-archive source tests, preserve existing local configuration/approval gates; native Windows and Android viewport acceptance remains pending.

planned_work.title: Document server-owned completed-game receipt and Tavi desktop presentation
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Schema checked, documentation no game SDK mint, legacy packages and repository unchanged, staged game/Wallet authority and real gameplay QA remain separate.

planned_work.title: Offline TaviX Store listing editor
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Private editor example imports and verifies package and lock, previews current and future Store layouts, exports draft and bumped package, no published metadata or Wallet authority; Windows/Android acceptance separate.

planned_work.title: Repair Windows UTF-8 Store Editor test portability
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Run ZipRunner Python build on Windows with default CP1252 decoding: Store Editor tests use explicit UTF-8; pass all tests and strict catalog without changing published extensions, config or approvals. Operator acceptance remains separate.

planned_work.title: Stage Klondike Solitaire 0.1.1 in public catalog for approval
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Stage exact package, test immutable release files, correct game classification and Android metadata; verify icon and catalog; native Android and publisher source/license review are separate gates.

planned_work.title: Archive obsolete example-org Klondike staging draft without deleting bytes
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Verify exact old/new package revisions, preserve 0.6.40 catalog, archive only the superseded draft to ignored local backup, pass Windows preflight/unit/strict checks before Git publication.

planned_work.title: Repair pre-overlay ZipRunner Workboard validation for Klondike staging
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: All implemented/remaining Workboard entries have nonempty bounded operator_checks; validate exact 0.1.22 ZIP on Windows; run guarded archive and strict source tests; preserve release and Git approval.

planned_work.title: Klondike optional Tavi Assets card back
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: 0.1.2 package loads offline without host, uses only granted org.tavi.cards.standard/card.back through tavi.assets/v1, clears transient visuals when refreshed/revoked, keeps 0.1.1 immutable and requires reviewed Store staging.
